method: Read-only guarded stock-car and replacement-engine literals in ob_car_Step_0; stock upper bounds and engine HP guards independently checked in both banks

conversions.native_grip: grip_raw / 1200 * 1.08; native calibration, not a recovered friction equation

limitations: Stock literals are recovered, not complete Android vehicle dynamics.
No real manufacturer model name is inferred from a number alone.
A mod skin inherits its source body mechanical record until explicit different source parameters exist.
